overview:
New Jersey's 11th District leans Democratic by about five points, and incumbent Analilia Mejia is seeking re-election. No general-election polls are available and no expert raters have published ratings for the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals. The national environment this cycle favors Democrats, adding to the district's inherent lean.

Mejia has raised about $1.8 million to Republican Joe Hathaway's $658,000, though both enter the final stretch with little cash on hand. Outside groups have spent modestly on both sides, with no recorded opposition spending against either nominee. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 95 percent. An independent candidate, Alan Bond, is on the ballot but shows no meaningful financial activity. All available evidence points to a comfortable Democratic advantage, with the incumbent favored to hold the seat.
